synopsis: One day, our protagonist was reborn as Alicia, a blind duchess in a fantasy world. In her previous life, she was sickly and spent all her time in the hospital, so she decided to enjoy her new life as much as possible, even though she was blind! She was living her reincarnated life to the fullest, playing with Kyle, the fifth prince, whom she befriended by chance, and training in magic. However, as Alicia grew up, inexplicable events began to occur. It seems that this world was not just a happy fantasy after all......? (Source: Regina Comics, translated) Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

This is a violent coming-of-age story about two people struggling in everyday life with no escape. (Source: Ichijin Plus, translated)
